Tagline: Stay compliant on every site — and beyond the gate.
HeroCopy: Keep your company documents and every operative's qualifications current, and prove it the moment a main contractor asks — on the site, or well away from any gate.

Features.Heading: Company documents
Features.Copy: Insurances, policies and accreditations in one place, current and shareable.

Features.Heading: Operative compliance
Features.Copy: Every card and qualification tracked, with expiry warnings before they lapse.

Features.Heading: Send a compliance pack
Features.Copy: Share proof with a main contractor who opens it with no account.

Features.Heading: Works beyond the site gate
Features.Copy: Manage a dispersed or retrofit workforce with no fixed gate to check in at.

Sections.Heading: CSCS card check, when you need it
Sections.Body: Add card verification as an option alongside your compliance record — no fuss, no upsell.

Tagline: Know who's compliant before they arrive.
HeroCopy: See a subcontractor's compliance ahead of time, run pre-arrival inductions, and manage a workforce even when the scheme has no single site gate.

Features.Heading: Pre-arrival induction
Features.Copy: Workers complete induction before they reach site, not at the gate.

Features.Heading: Workforce visibility
Features.Copy: One view of who is compliant across every subcontractor on the job.

Features.Heading: Dispersed & retrofit schemes
Features.Copy: Workforce management when there isn't a site gate to control access.

Sections.Heading: Workforce management when there isn't a site gate
Sections.Body: Retrofit and dispersed schemes rarely have a single entrance to check anyone in at. Tedwren treats a whole scheme as one site: induct workers before they arrive, see who is compliant across every subcontractor, and keep that picture current wherever the work actually happens — street by street, home by home. It's the same control a gated site gives you, without the gate.
